validCredentials.description: A well-formed, registered email + password pair signs in and lands on the Home screen.

incorrectPassword.description: This build's login always succeeds against its own mock backend regardless of the password typed - verified live (a deliberately wrong password still reaches Home, authenticated as a fixed demo account). Documents that behavior explicitly rather than leaving it an unexplained surprise.

blankCredentials.description: Tapping Sign In with both fields empty shows 'Email is required' and 'Password is required', without ever calling the network.

malformedEmail.description: An email with no '@' fails Flutter's own client-side format validation before any network call, showing 'Enter a valid email address'.
